knitting.sentenceEn: A woman encouraged to try knitting and crocheting after developing an autoimmune disease that caused a lot of hand pain reported on the Craft Yarn Council site that her hands are now less stiff and painful.
knitting.translationZh: 一位女性在患上自身免疫性疾病并导致严重手部疼痛后，尝试了编织和钩织。她在Craft Yarn Council网站上分享说，现在她的手不再那么僵硬和疼痛了。

knitting.sentenceEn: I for one try not to miss a single weekly meeting of my knitting group.
knitting.translationZh: 就我个人而言，我尽量不错过编织小组每周的任何一次聚会。

knitting.sentenceEn: Perhaps most exciting is research that suggests that crafts like knitting and crocheting may help to keep off a decline in brain function with age.
knitting.translationZh: 或许最令人兴奋的是，有研究表明编织和钩织等手工艺可能有助于延缓随年龄增长而出现的大脑功能衰退。

knitting.sentenceEn: Once you get beyond the initial learning curve, knitting and crocheting can lower heart rate and blood pressure.
knitting.translationZh: 一旦度过最初的学习阶段，编织和钩织就能降低心率和血压。

knitting.sentenceEn: Betsan Corkhill, a wellness coach in Bath, England, and author of the book Knit for Health & Wellness, established a website, Stitchlinks, to explore the value of what she calls therapeutic knitting .
knitting.translationZh: 英国巴斯的健康教练、《编织促进健康与 wellness》一书的作者Betsan Corkhill建立了一个名为Stitchlinks的网站，以探索她所说的治疗性编织的价值。

knitting.sentenceEn: Knitting can help people stay away from tobacco.
knitting.translationZh: 编织可以帮助人们远离烟草。

keen.sentenceEn: "I'm very keen to encourage young people," she says, observing that design brings together other subjects such as literature, art, history, geography and science.
keen.translationZh: “我非常热衷于鼓励年轻人，”她说，并指出设计能将文学、艺术、历史、地理和科学等其他学科融会贯通。

keen.sentenceEn: He's always keen on physical activities.
keen.translationZh: 他总是热衷于体育活动。
keen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

keen.sentenceEn: "Consider a scientist who is a keen rock climber," says Kelly.
keen.translationZh: 凯利说：“想想一位热衷于攀岩的科学家。”
keen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

keen.sentenceEn: W: Mm… I'm not keen on him.
keen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第16段，第1句

keen.sentenceEn: Many of the highest earners have a keen interest in and love for what they are doing.
keen.translationZh: 许多收入最高的人对自己所做的事情怀有浓厚的兴趣和热爱。

keen.sentenceEn: They were as keen as he was on financial matters.
keen.translationZh: 他们和他一样对财务问题充满热情。

kindergarten.sentenceEn: Children don't just show up to the first day of kindergarten and have the idea of reputation pop suddenly into existence.
kindergarten.translationZh: 孩子们不会刚上幼儿园第一天，就突然有了名誉的概念。
kindergarten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

kindergarten.sentenceEn: Almost all of these students will be in kindergarten through high school, but 66 will be in prekindergarten and other programs.
kindergarten.translationZh: 这些学生几乎都将就读于幼儿园至高中，但有66名将在学前班及其他项目中就读。
kindergarten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

kindergarten.sentenceEn: At whatever grade level teachers find themselves, from kindergarten to the final class at medical or law school, few moments stir the emotions as deeply as when former students reappear years and often decades later with an update on where their journey has taken them and what resiliencies(韧性) have been the pavement on which they've traveled.
kindergarten.translationZh: 无论教师身处哪个教育阶段——从幼儿园到医学院或法学院的最后一堂课——很少有什么时刻能像多年甚至数十年后，昔日学生再次出现，讲述他们人生旅程的去向，以及哪些韧性成为了他们人生道路上的铺路石那样，深深触动人心。

kindergarten.sentenceEn: For the study, researchers compared teacher and parent evaluations of American children who started kindergarten in 1998, with those who began school in 2010.
kindergarten.translationZh: 在这项研究中，研究人员比较了教师和家长对1998年开始上幼儿园的美国儿童与2010年开始上学的美国儿童的评价。
kindergarten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

kindergarten.sentenceEn: The former group entered kindergarten when mobile phones were luxuries.
kindergarten.translationZh: 前一组儿童进入幼儿园时，手机还是奢侈品。
kindergarten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

kindergarten.sentenceEn: One quarter of teachers in an American city said that children in kindergartens had no time for playing freely.
kindergarten.translationZh: 美国一座城市有四分之一的教师报告称，幼儿园的孩子们根本没有自由玩耍的时间。

kilometer.sentenceEn: He then drove three kilometers across town before getting on the highway.
kilometer.translationZh: 随后，他驾车穿过城镇行驶了三公里，然后开上了高速公路。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

kilometer.sentenceEn: A four-year-old girl has walked eight kilometers through a snowy forest to seek help for her sick grandmother who later died of a heart attack.
kilometer.translationZh: 一名四岁女童在雪地森林中跋涉八公里，为生病的祖母求助。这位祖母后来因心脏病发作去世。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

kilometer.sentenceEn: W: Well, it's five kilometers from home to the office.
kilometer.translationZh: 女：嗯，从我家到办公室有五公里呢。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

kilometer.sentenceEn: This included rebuilding about 50 kilometers of fencing.
kilometer.translationZh: 这包括重建约50公里的围栏。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

kilometer.translationZh: 哦，那家店在15公里远的地方。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第3句

kilometer.sentenceEn: The speed of the bus was 24 kilometers per hour at the time of the collision.
kilometer.translationZh: 碰撞发生时，公交车的行驶速度为24公里/小时。
kilometer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

knit.sentenceEn: The Craft Yarn Council reports that a third of women ages 25-35 now knit or crochet.
knit.translationZh: 美国手工艺纱线协会报告显示，目前25-35岁女性中有三分之一的人从事编织或钩织活动。

knit.sentenceEn: A 2009 University of British Columbia study of 38 women with an eating disorder who were taught to knit found that learning the craft led to significant improvements.
knit.translationZh: 2009年，英属哥伦比亚大学对38名患有饮食失调症的女性进行了一项研究，这些女性被教授编织技艺。研究发现，学习这项手工艺给她们带来了显著改善。

knit.sentenceEn: For example, Karen Hayes, a life coach in Toronto, conducts knitting therapy programs, including Knit to Quit to help smokers give up the habit, and Knit to Heal for people coping with health crises, like a cancer diagnosis or serious illness of a family member.
knit.translationZh: 例如，多伦多的生活教练凯伦·海耶斯开展了编织疗法项目，其中包括“编织戒烟”项目以帮助吸烟者戒除烟瘾，以及“编织疗愈”项目，面向那些正应对健康危机的人群，如被诊断患有癌症或家人患重病的人。

knit.sentenceEn: Betsan Corkhill, a wellness coach in Bath, England, and author of the book Knit for Health & Wellness, established a website, Stitchlinks, to explore the value of what she calls therapeutic knitting.
knit.translationZh: 英国巴斯的健康教练、《编织促进健康与 wellness》一书的作者Betsan Corkhill建立了一个名为Stitchlinks的网站，以探索她所说的治疗性编织的价值。

knit.sentenceEn: Among them is the father of a prematurely born daughter who reported that during the baby's five weeks in the intensive care unit, "learning how to knit infant hats gave me a sense of purpose during a time that I felt very helpless. It's a hobby that I've stuck with, and it continues to help me cope with stress at work, provide a sense of order in hectic(忙乱的) days, and allow my brain time to solve problems."
knit.translationZh: 其中包括一位早产女儿的父亲，他说在女儿入住重症监护室的五个星期里，“学习编织婴儿帽让我在感到非常无助的时候找到了一种目标感。这是一个我一直坚持的爱好，它继续帮助我应对工作中的压力，在忙乱的日子里带来一种秩序感，并让我的大脑有时间解决问题。”

knit.sentenceEn: When people are knitting , they tend to eat fewer snacks.
knit.translationZh: 人们编织时，往往会少吃零食。

kindness.sentenceEn: The board has messages of kindness like, "If you want more kindness in the world, put it here."
kindness.translationZh: 这块留言板上写着一些充满善意的话语，比如：“如果你希望世界充满更多善意，就从这里开始吧。”
kindness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

kindness.sentenceEn: Last month, Atria Books published her book The Rabbit Effect: Live Longer, Happier, and Healthier with the Groundbreaking Science of Kindness .
kindness.translationZh: 上个月，阿特里亚图书公司出版了她的著作《兔子效应：用突破性的善意科学活得更长久、更快乐、更健康》。

kindness.sentenceEn: While his father commented on how proud he was of his son, yet, Mike isn't looking for praise, but kindness in return.
kindness.translationZh: 尽管父亲表示为儿子感到无比自豪，但迈克并不寻求赞扬，只希望得到善意的回报。
kindness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

kindness.sentenceEn: Many are hoping the simple act of kindness spreads.
kindness.translationZh: 许多人都希望这种简单的善举能够传播开来。
kindness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第12句

kindness.sentenceEn: According to Kelli Harding, rabbits' health had more to do with humans' kindness to them than their diet or genetics.
kindness.translationZh: 根据凯莉·哈丁的说法，兔子的健康状况与其饮食或基因关系不大，而更多地取决于人类对它们的友善态度。

kindness.sentenceEn: Most staffers have received messages of kindness .
kindness.translationZh: 大多数员工都收到了善意的留言

kilogram.sentenceEn: It can measure up to 2 meters long and weigh around 204 kilograms .
kilogram.translationZh: 它可以长达2米，重约204公斤。
kilogram.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

kilogram.sentenceEn: At around 20 kilograms per person global fish consumption is now more than twice what it was in the 1960s.
kilogram.translationZh: 目前全球人均鱼类消费量约为20公斤，是20世纪60年代的两倍多。
kilogram.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

kilogram.sentenceEn: It is a female and she weighs nearly 130 kilograms .
kilogram.translationZh: 这是一头雌性小象，体重近130公斤。
kilogram.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

kilogram.sentenceEn: According to the official news agency, Russian authorities have recovered more than 170 gold bars weighing 20 kilograms each.
kilogram.translationZh: 据官方通讯社报道，俄罗斯当局已找回170多根金条，每根重20公斤。
kilogram.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

kilogram.sentenceEn: The Savannahs are tall and slim and can weigh up to 9.1 kilograms , making them one of the largest breeds of cats that people can own.
kilogram.translationZh: 萨凡纳猫身形高挑纤瘦，体重可达9.1公斤，是人们能饲养的体型最大的猫品种之一。
kilogram.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

kilogram.sentenceEn: A device that weighs less than one kilogram is part of a mission that will allow scientists to deliver fourth generation or 4G mobile coverage to the moon in 2019.
kilogram.translationZh: 一个重量不足一公斤的设备将参与一项任务，该任务使科学家能在2019年为月球提供第四代（4G）移动网络覆盖。
kilogram.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句
